gam-econ-pt-001-q1.reason: An independent adjudicator, shown the pack's questions without its source, could narrow this question using gam-econ-pt-001-q1 (intra-question self-disclosure), gam-econ-pt-001-q2. Two compounding mechanisms, both unchanged by the withdrawal of q4. (1) INTRA-QUESTION NUMERIC RECONSTRUCTION: 481.60 divided by the stem tonnage of 120.4 is exactly 4.00, and it is the only option that divides to a round figure, so the undisclosed general-cargo rate is recoverable from the option set alone. Three of the four options are the same rate under three roundings — 480 = 120 x 4, 481.60 = 120.4 x 4, 484 = 121 x 4 — so the tariff row the item is meant to test is handed over, leaving only the rounding rule to be read. (2) q2 stem presupposition plus doctrinal coupling: q2 asserts the per-class minimum regime, and with the rate recovered as 4 the tonnage fee is far above a 200 floor, so option a falls without the source. The two compound, because eliminating 200 is only valid once the rate is known. Narrowing rather than decisive: no sibling fixes the rounding convention, which is the residual discriminator.
